### CloudWatch Log Groups

```{python}

import os
import boto3

# Create a CloudWatch Logs client
client = boto3.client('logs')

# Initialize an empty list to store log group names
log_group_names = []

# Use pagination to get all log groups
paginator = client.get_paginator('describe_log_groups')
for page in paginator.paginate():
    for log_group in page['logGroups']:
        log_group_names.append(log_group['logGroupName'])

# Print the list of log group names
print(log_group_names)

```

```{python}

# Apply retention policy for each log group
for log_group in log_group_names:
    command = f"aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name {log_group} --retention-in-days 30"
    os.system(command)

```

```{bash}

aws logs describe-log-groups --query 'logGroups[].[logGroupName, retentionInDays]' --output table

```

```{bash}
aws logs describe-log-groups
```

### AWS Services Calling KMS

```{bash}

aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com \
  --query 'Events[*].CloudTrailEvent' \
  --output text | jq -s -r '.[] | .userIdentity.invokedBy' > kms_logs.txt

```

```{bash}

aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --max-results 100 > kms-events.txt

```


```{bash}

set -euo pipefail

# Force use of jq 1.7 from Windows Chocolatey
export PATH="/c/ProgramData/chocolatey/bin:$PATH"

# Output CSV
output_csv="kms_usage_summary.csv"
echo "KeyARN,Service,Region,WeekStart,UsageCount" > "$output_csv"

# Get regions
regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[*].RegionName' --output text)

# Time window: last 12 weeks
start_time=$(date -u -d '12 weeks ago' +%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z)
end_time=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z)

# Get all KMS key ARNs as JSON array
kms_arns=$(for arn in $(aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[*].KeyArn' --output text); do echo "\"$arn\""; done | jq -s .)

for region in $regions; do
  echo "Processing region: $region"

  # Use CLI pagination and full output
  aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
    --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com \
    --start-time "$start_time" --end-time "$end_time" \
    --region "$region" \
    --output json \
    --no-cli-pager \
  | jq -rc --argjson arns "$kms_arns" --arg region "$region" '
      .Events[]
      | .CloudTrailEvent
      | fromjson
      | select(.eventName | test("Encrypt|Decrypt|ReEncrypt|GenerateDataKey|GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext|GenerateMac|VerifyMac|Sign|Verify"))
      | {
          keyarn: (
            (.resources[]?.ARN // .requestParameters.keyId) // "unknown"
          ),
          service: (
            .userIdentity.invokedBy //
            .userIdentity.type //
            "unknown"
          ),
          region: $region,
          week: (
            .eventTime
            | strptime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            | strftime("%G-W%V")
          )
        }
    ' | jq -s '
      group_by(.keyarn + .service + .region + .week)
      | map({
          keyarn: .[0].keyarn,
          service: .[0].service,
          region: .[0].region,
          week: .[0].week,
          count: length
        })' \
    | jq -rc '.[] | [.keyarn, .service, .region, .week, .count] | @csv' >> "$output_csv"
done

echo "Saved summary to $output_csv"


```
